data.narrative:
Bedrock Robotics is a Series B robotics and manufacturing company founded by Boris Sofman, Kevin Peterson, Ajay Gummalla, and Tom Eliaz. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of nine private companies and one public comparable (277810.KQ) operating in the same sector and adjacent stages. Primary peers include Generalist AI, Dexterity, Divergent, Exotec, and Locus Robotics, which establish meaningful stage and sector benchmarks.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, anchoring to the last post-money valuation of $1.75B and applying a typical Series B-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 1.9x, yields an implied valuation of $3.3B. Peer-median analysis across five same-sector and same/adjacent-stage comparables (Generalist AI at $2.0B, Dexterity at $1.6B, Humanoid at $1.4B, Agile Robots at $1.0B, and Nimble Robotics at $1.0B) produces a median valuation of $1.4B, with a range spanning $1.0B to $2.0B.

The triangulated valuation range is $1.1B to $3.8B, with a median of $2.3B. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty around stage-specific valuation multiples versus near-term peer comparability. Key risks include competitive positioning relative to the five-company peer cluster and whether the Series B step-up multiplier of 1.9x reflects market conditions for this cohort. Current post-money valuation of $1.75B sits in the lower-middle portion of this range.
